agent_response.rootCause: Kotlin NPE: Accessing viewModel before initialization
fixGuidelines: 1. Ensure that the ViewModel (viewModel) is properly initialized by calling it in onCreate() or another appropriate lifecycle method.
2. Add an initialization block where the ViewModel can be created and assigned to the var declaration.
3. Modify the code at app/src/main/kotlin/MainActivity.kt:42 to initialize viewModel before accessing it.
